digest.headline: Renewal invoice credit is now a two customer problem
digest.summary: The renewal invoice credit theme picked up a second customer this week, described in completely different language from the first. One new theme opened, on single sign on provisioning. Nothing went quiet.

sections.heading: Renewal invoices do not show prior dues credit
sections.body: Two customers now report that a renewal invoice arrives with the full annual amount and no line for dues already paid. Both correct it by hand before the invoice goes out.

sections.heading: Single sign on provisioning drops staff role changes
sections.body: Role changes made in the identity provider did not reach the membership records.
